ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity pixel values (black) with high-intensity (white) regions localized to the distal tips and specific mottling zones. Estimated ratio of 7:1 (black to white).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous black region occupying the central and lower 80% of the fluke area. High-intensity white pixel clusters (mottling) are visible on the upper half of the left lobe and localized at both distal lobe tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide V-shaped indentation with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 75 degrees; the notch depth is roughly 12% of the total vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Discrete irregular pixel-level variations and low-amplitude serrations along the trailing edge. The outer 25% of each lobe shows higher frequency irregularities compared to the smoother central region near the notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the upper trailing edge leading to tapered, slightly upturned distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular white pixel anomalies (approximately 10-15 per tip) concentrated at the extreme distal edges of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple fine, high-contrast linear segments (rake marks) detected. Notable diagonal tracks on the mid-left lobe and horizontal linear disruptions on the mid-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive peripheral colonization of calcified organisms (barnacles) at both lobe tips and various linear surface abrasions across the ventral pigment.
